description: Held-out positive corpus: natural paraphrases of the situations Sense is meant to help with, written as a user would type them rather than copied from the prompt pack. `capture` records whether an image capture is the correct answer; a prompt with capture=false that routes to a take_* tool is an unrequested-capture failure and fails CI. Everything else is scored, not gated.
